subject: Post-demo: schema compatibility, constrained decoding & retry plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@aureliushealth.com>, Tariq Rahman <tariq@aureliushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & technical clarifications (schema + retries)

Hi Elena / Tariq — great demo today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + a couple of clarifying questions so our engineering follow-up can be focused: 

Recap (2 min):
- Your core use case: patient-summary ingestion => structured care-recommendation JSON + vector embeddings for similarity search / reranker.
- Success metric: 99% schema-compliant responses for the top 6 fields (diagnosis_code, recommended_action, urgency_level, rationale, confidence_score, patient_id) and <200ms 95p latency for short responses.

Clarifying questions (so we scope the reliability work):
1) Which fields are strict (must validate) vs advisory? I saw you mark diagnosis_code and patient_id as strict in the spreadsheet but want confirmation.
2) For constrained decoding, are you OK with server-side validation + auto-retry up to N=2, or do you need an in-model constrained decoding approach first?
3) Embeddings: are the vectors used solely for indexing + reranker, or will you also do live nearest-neighbor lookups in the request path (impacts latency/design)?

Attachments: I attached a first-pass schema (schema_proposal_v1.json) and the prompt set you used in the demo (aurelius_mvp_promptset.json).

Next steps (proposed):
- Tech deep-dive: 60m with Aurelius infra + our solutions engineer to lock auth/routing and retry semantics (propose Fri 6/18 10am PT).
- Internal prep: our engs will draft a validation + retry playbook and a recommended SDK integration checklist.

If you confirm the answers to Q1–Q3 and Fri works, I’ll send the calendar invite and the preliminary playbook.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192
From: Elena Soto <elena@aureliushealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Tariq Rahman <tariq@aureliushealth.com>, Aurelius Health Infra <infra@aureliushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & technical clarifications (schema + retries)

Thanks Jasmine — enjoyed the walkthrough. Quick answers: 

- Q1: Strict fields = diagnosis_code, patient_id, urgency_level, confidence_score. Rationale and recommended_action can be advisory but should follow the shape.
- Q2: We prefer server-side validation + retry initially (auto-retry N=2) to move faster; if we see >1% failures in staging we’ll evaluate in-model constraints.
- Q3: Embeddings are used both for offline similarity (batch) and a live reranker call in the request path; reranker must be sub-100ms tail for top-K=5.

Friday 6/18 10am PT works, looping infra (infra@aureliushealth.com) for auth/network questions.

Elena
VP Product, Aurelius Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Aurelius follow-up — recommended approach

Internal notes — recommended sequence to present on Fri: 

1) Validation policy: server-side schema validation as the first line. If validation fails, run a constrained-decode retry (prompt + token filter) and fall back to a permissive parsing attempt. Limit retries to 2. 
2) Constrained decoding vs post-hoc validation: start with post-hoc validation + retry; reserved recommendation: if failures persist, enable constrained decoding using our constrained-token policy or grammar-based soft prompts.
3) SDK + auth: propose short-term: API key + IP allowlist for pilot; recommended long-term: mTLS and per-route token scoping for production. Document these in the SDK checklist.
4) Routing & failover: prioritize low-latency model (opt-fast) for live path, fallback to higher-throughput quantized var (opt-quant) for degraded capacity. Use smart-routing by request tag (live_v_rerank vs batch_embed).
5) Embeddings & reranker: keep embeddings as separate async pipeline for batch indexing; for live reranker do a synchronous call but pre-warm the reranker model and use prefix caching for common queries.

Action items: 
- Dev: draft SDK auth + example (mTLS + short-lived tokens) and a code snippet for validation+retry. (dev_patel)
- Neha: prepare a short doc on constrained-decoding tradeoffs + observability signals we’ll track (neha_kapoor)
- Jasmine: coordinate Fri invite + external summary.

Attach: redwood_sdk_integration_checklist.pdf (for reference).

-Marissa
Director, Solutions Engineering
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Internal: Aurelius follow-up — recommended approach

Working on the SDK snippet and a lightweight validation/retry pattern — draft below. I’ll attach fuller examples to the drive doc.

Snippet (pseudo-curl / pseudo-python):

// server-side validation + retry (pseudo)
POST /generate -> model response r1
if not validate_schema(r1):
  // retry with constrained decoding hint
  r2 = generate_with_constraints(prompt, constraints=field_json_schema, max_retries=1)
  if validate_schema(r2):
    return r2
  else:
    log_failure(r2); return error_response(422, explanation)

Key infra notes:
- Use per-route short-lived tokens (30s) for reranker calls to limit blast radius.
- For live path, set batch_size=1, but enable request coalescing for similar prefixes to avoid starvation.
- Telemetry: track field-level validation pass rate, avg-retries-per-request, and model-fallback-rate.

I’ll upload the code examples and a test harness to the drive by EOD.

-Dev

Thanks — confirmed for Fri 2026-06-18 10:00 AM PT. Summary of what we’ll cover and deliverables so the call is efficient: 

1) Validation + retry playbook (we’ll walk the server-side validation -> constrained-retry -> permissive fallback flow). Deliverable: short playbook + sample harness.
2) SDK/auth integration approach (pilot: API key + IP allowlist; production: mTLS + scoped tokens). Deliverable: SDK checklist + code snippets.
3) Routing & model fallback (priority for live reranker, fallback to quantized model under load). Deliverable: routing policy draft.
4) Embeddings plan (batch indexing + live reranker flow); we’ll discuss pre-warming options for the reranker.

Attachments linked: schema_proposal_v1.json, aurelius_mvp_promptset.json, redwood_sdk_integration_checklist.pdf
